description: Where the places in data/names.json are, for the reader's maps: keyed "strong|lemma|name", each a point [longitude, latitude], whether its site is known, OpenBible's confidence in it (0 to 1000), and whether it is an area (a region, river, sea or island: drawn as a label, not a dot). "more" locates the same way the proper nouns data/names.json has no card for yet, keyed "strong|lemma|MACULA's gloss", in the verses listed. Written by scripts/extract_places.py.
